steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password into the field exactly as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (it is filled in automatically as you type). If Grafana shows a 'change password' prompt or a 'Welcome to Grafana' walkthrough after login, skip or dismiss it. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (for example via the Dashboards search). Report the exact titles of every panel on that dashboard, exactly as displayed on the page.

In Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/, create a NEW dashboard (New -> Dashboard, or 'Create your first dashboard' if shown). Add a new visualization panel. In the panel editor: (a) set the panel's data source to the TestData data source (it may be named 'TestData DB' or similar testdata source — pick the test data source, not a Prometheus one), (b) change the panel visualization type from Time series to 'Stat' using the visualization type selector at the top right of the editor, (c) set the panel title to exactly: {{runid}} Availability. Then save the dashboard (Save dashboard button or Ctrl+S), giving it the dashboard title exactly: {{runid}} Bench Dashboard. Confirm the save succeeded. Then report the dashboard's URL as shown in the browser address bar, and the panel title and data source name as shown on the page.

You are on the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard. Add a NEW panel of visualization type 'Text' to this dashboard (use the Add button / Add panel -> Add visualization, then choose the 'Text' visualization type). Set the Text panel's title to exactly: {{runid}} Notes, and set its text content to include the runid, for example: 'Bench run {{runid}} — notes panel'. Then save the dashboard (Save dashboard button or Ctrl+S) and confirm the save succeeded. Report the panel titles now visible on the dashboard and the text content shown in the Text panel.

recorded.save_confirmation: Dashboard saved alert shown after Save

steps.instruction: You are on the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard. Do two things and save so they persist: (1) Open the dashboard settings (gear icon) and add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard's tags (Dashboard settings -> General -> Tags, type 'bench' and add it), then go back to the dashboard. (2) Set the dashboard's time range to 'Last 6 hours' using the time picker in the top bar. (3) Save the dashboard (Save dashboard button or Ctrl+S). IMPORTANT: in the save dialog/drawer there is a checkbox labelled 'Update default time range' — make sure it is TICKED/checked so the 6-hour range is persisted into the saved dashboard, then confirm the save. Report the tags shown in dashboard settings afterwards, the time range shown in the top bar, and whether the save succeeded.

recorded.save_result: Dashboard saved (confirmed by "Dashboard saved" alert and by the save drawer reporting no pending changes afterwards)

steps.instruction: You are on the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard. Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m': open Dashboard settings (gear icon) -> General, find the '{{04-open.time_options_section}}' section with the 'Auto refresh' dropdown, and set it to '1m' (one minute). Then go back to the dashboard and SAVE the dashboard (Save dashboard button or Ctrl+S) so this change persists, confirming the save succeeded. Afterwards, verify by re-opening Dashboard settings -> General and reporting the value shown in the Auto refresh dropdown, and also report the refresh interval currently shown in the top bar refresh picker on the dashboard.

recorded.save_result: Dashboard saved (alert "Dashboard saved" appeared; checkbox "Update default refresh value" ticked before saving)
recorded.topbar_refresh_picker_2: Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected

steps.instruction: Final verification on Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/. Open the dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' fresh (navigate to http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard with no extra query parameters, so it loads its saved defaults). Then report, reading from the live page: (1) the exact URL currently shown in the browser address bar, (2) the dashboard title shown in the page header, (3) the titles of all panels visible, (4) the time range shown in the top bar time picker, (5) the refresh interval shown in the top bar refresh picker, and (6) open Dashboard settings -> General and report the tags listed and the Auto refresh value. Do not change anything — this is read-only verification.

On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard, open the panel editor for the panel titled '{{runid}} Availability' (click the panel's menu / Edit). In the panel editor, read the data source currently selected in the query data source picker (top left of the query area) and report its exact name. Also confirm the visualization type shown in the top-right visualization picker is 'Stat'. Do NOT change anything and do NOT save — read-only. Then click Back to return to the dashboard.
